Ravenmoor University Computer Science - VAX 3
Operator on duty tonight: nell (B-wing, x4471)

Reminder: the Halloween backup run starts at 23:00.
Do NOT touch the tape drives while it runs.

children.name: riddle
children.content:
i have keys but open no locks.
i have space but no room.
you can enter, but you can't go inside.
what am i?   -- n.

children.name: README
children.content:
Welcome, guest.

Try these:
  ls          list files
  cat FILE    read a file
  cd DIR      go into a directory
  help        list every command

children.name: .from_nell
children.content:
you found a dot-file!! jack skips these. lazy pumpkin :-P

things i know:
- jack is NOT a ghost. he's a program. programs can be stopped.
- `ps` shows what's running. `ps aux` shows EVERYTHING.
- jack makes things i don't understand. you're from 2026. you will.

-- n.   (write me anytime: write nell)

children.name: .plan
children.content:
night shift again :-P
if the backup tape jams one more time i'm going to haunt this machine.

children.name: notes
children.content:
- tape 3 is the bad one. always tape 3.
- printer 2 eats paper after midnight. coincidence??
- ask prof. hale about the weird lights in the B-wing.

children.name: .diary
children.content:
dear diary,
the lights flickered again. the machine hummed a tune i didn't know.
if anyone reads this: it's not a ghost. it's me. probably.

Hello,

Nell Voss is the night operator tonight. If anything odd happens
with the machine, ask her (she's usually logged in; try "write nell").

Please do NOT touch the tape drives. The Halloween backup is running
and tape 3 has been acting up again.

Whatever you hear from the B-wing: it's the air handlers. Probably.

-- A. Hale
